description:
Operating Area: Greece, Turkey, Ionian Sea, East Mediterranean, Aegean Sea

Ariela is a luxurious 40-meter motor yacht with the ultimate in-deck spaces and top-of-the-line accommodations for 12 people. The tri-deck motor yacht was built by the Italian famous shipyard CRN in Ancona. Enjoy elegant interiors designed by Zuccon International Project, the epitome of comfort and sophistication. For those looking for a bespoke yachting experience, Ariela has a full-beam master suite on the main deck forward with a study room and large bathroom,  and also additional 2 VIP and 3 double cabins. On board, you'll find everything from the latest in audio and video technology to a huge collection of board games and DVDs. wakeboards, waterskis, and snorkeling gear are among the water toys on offer aboard Ariela for those who enjoy making the most of their surroundings. Ariela also include a luxury jacuzzi on the sundeck ideal for rest and relaxation with good company and cold champagne. 

With a refit in 2023 and state-of-the-art technology throughout, Ariela is ready to take you on an unforgettable adventure on the Aegean Sea or off the coast of Turkey or Greece. Book your charter today and get ready to indulge in the ultimate luxury yachting experience.

crew.name: Taha Yasin CALCI
crew.bio:
Age: 35
Gender: Male 
Nationality: Turkish 
Born in: Istanbul 
Marital status: Single 
Education: University
Languages spoken: Turkish (native), English (fluent)

Captain Taha Yasin Calci was born in Istanbul and has been part of the yachting industry since 2015. Holds a Master’s Licensee, permitted to command all types of yachts up to 499grt all over the world.  He has cruised extensively throughout the East Mediterranean, including the Adriatic, the Ionian and the Aegean Seas. 
Over the past 8 years, Taha has worked on prestigious vessels including Arcadia 115, Sanlorenzo SL96, and  Sunseeker 105. He has the overall command, oversees the yacht’s operation and management, the crew duties and the yacht’s itinerary.

Taha brings a structured, safety-first approach to every voyage. He has a proven ability in not only navigation and engineering, but also in leadership, budgeting, and crew development.
He is known for creating smooth and bespoke charter experiences, carefully tailoring each route to guest preferences—whether it’s exploring the hidden bays of the Turkish Riviera, the charm of the Greek Islands in the Aegean Sea, or the dramatic coasts of the Adriatic.

Calm under pressure, with highly knowledgeable, and  professionalism, Captain Taha ensures an unforgettable and seamless journey onboard.

Şahin is a highly skilled and creative yacht chef with over 18 years of culinary experience in luxury hospitality and yachting. He specializes in Mediterranean, Asian, Middle Eastern, and international cuisines with a strong focus on healthy, modern, and flavorful cooking. He also incorporates molecular gastronomy and decorative plating into his repertoire.

His yachting background includes working as Head Chef on board M/S Meira (55m charter), M/Y Lady Soul (35m), and most recently M/Y Parsley (40m private). He has designed full seasonal menus, delivered formal multi-course dinners, and consistently maintained top hygiene standards.

Şahin’s passion for food, adaptability, and deep understanding of guest preferences make him a valuable asset on both private and charter yachts.

With extensive hands-on experience across Turkey and Greek waters, Gokmen Oksuz brings strong technical expertise and operational support to the engine room. His professional background includes working on board several luxury yachts from 30m to 45m , in positions ranging from deckhand to oiler.

His role as a yacht engineer involves all aspects of mechanical maintenance, tender operations, engine room organization, and assistance during maneuvering. Gokmen has a solid understanding of vessel operations and is experienced in mooring, anchoring, watchkeeping, and assisting during guest transfers.

His versatility and willingness to support all departments make him a valuable member of the crew, especially in busy charter environments.

Sevgi is a highly experienced Chief Stewardess with a strong background in luxury hospitality and yachting, holding a degree in Tourism and Hotel Management from Balikesir University. With over a decade of industry experience, including prominent roles on yachts such as M/Y MY TWIINZ (33m), M/Y ICE LADY (46m), and M/Y TUTKU (35m), she has built a solid reputation for delivering 5-star service.

She has excellent knowledge of hotel silver service, wine service, setting tables, bar service, and housekeeping. Her training includes internationally recognized courses in superyacht hospitality, food and beverage service, interior maintenance, and flower arrangements.

Sevgi is an energetic, self-motivated, and very friendly person, dedicated to exceeding guest expectations and ensuring every detail is cared for. She is responsible for all aspects of interior management, including dining service, welcoming guests onboard, guest relations, and coordinating special requests to perfection.

Erhan was born in Ankara, raised in the Aegean region of Turkey, and he began his career in the Turkish Navy. Working on various ships and boats, he performed all his duties successfully. Erhan has cruised extensively throughout the Turkish Coast and the Aegean Sea.
Over the 5 years background in luxury charter yachts, he currently serves as a skilled and reliable First Mate, combining technical proficiency with a strong sense of guest service.

In addition to his onboard duties, he has also served as a chase boat captain on high-performance vessels.

Erhan’s expertise includes yacht preparation, mechanical and electronic maintenance, guest transfers, and overall operational support. His career trajectory reflects a solid work ethic, technical know-how, and a dependable character that earns trust from both captains and guests alike.
Known for his calm demeanor, adaptability, and teamwork, he plays a key role in ensuring seamless and safe voyages. Erhan continues to grow as a maritime professional, bringing dedication and enthusiasm to every charter experience.
